en.html:
Ordinary methods were not getting me out of this. Try them this way, try them that way—same problem.
Then something extraordinary would have to do the work.

なるまい。
　尋常ならざる業をもって立ち向かうほかにない。

en.html:
I worked my breathing around the center below my navel, gathering the power within. Now then. This power—what was I going to do with it?
Choices
  • Flow—Turning (positive polarity).
  • Flow—Returning (negative polarity).
  • Flow—Ending.
